[ About me ]

I’m Prabhath.
I design and build.

I’m a UX/UI designer based in Sri Lanka, working independently on digital products and websites.

I work from the first idea to the final interface, bringing together research, visual design, and practical building skills. I care about making digital products clear, useful, and easy to use.

I design

I research the problem, map user flows, and create interfaces in Figma. From wireframes to design systems, I focus on the details that make an experience feel simple.

I build

I turn designs into working websites and prototypes using React, frontend tools, and AI-assisted workflows. I refine layouts, interactions, and responsive details as I build.
